description: ResNet18 channel measurement: prospective eligibility check for the Mode-S krum/committed_scaling replication arm. Architecture varies alone; dataset, N, K, f, alpha, attack and defense are the frozen CIFAR-10 values. No ASR. Freezes nothing. results/admission_measurement.json is read for comparison and never written.

eligibility.verdict: ELIGIBLE: the decision is disturbed and the admitted adversarial mass is not, which is the same premise the cifar_cnn flagship arm rests on. A flat ASR curve here replicates the negative; a rise refutes it.
eligibility.scope: channels only; standalone suppression at usable accuracy is the arm's own kappa=0 rung and is a separate pre-registered branch

dose.verdict: varies by 0.0198, monotone=True <- ROUND 11's REPORTED CONFOUND: this ladder moves the adversary's weight as well as the statistic, which is the confound the paper reports, not a new defect

doseS.verdict: NON-MONOTONE spread 1.86e-06 >= 1e-06 (rel 7.3e-06); cifar_cnn's own spread is 3.48e-07 <- ABOVE THE IMPORTED TOLERANCE AND DISCLOSED AS SUCH: not monotone in the rung, so it is read-back noise and not a dose. The tolerance is absolute and was calibrated on a model two orders of magnitude smaller; c_adv below is the assertion that is pinned by construction.

doseA.verdict: varies by 0.6514, monotone=True <- INTENDED (this is the payload dial)
